dom.title: LAiDIES — SUNNYVAiLE
dom.bodyText: LAı DIES Latest Episode Start learning Look it up Activities Explore SUNNYVAiLE KSVL 99.9 Account status Join the town > LAiDIES ONLINE · CONNECTED TO THE REWIND ERA_ AI fluency, taught through the pop culture you never forgot. Made to click. Built to stick. LAiDIES helps women understand and use AI through stories, practical tools, games, music and community. Welcome to the Rewind Era—twenty years of pop culture, from dial-up to downloads (1990–2010)—and to SUNNYVAiLE, the learning town where Girl Power meets Machine Power. Be kind, rewind. Put the pop-culture encyclopedia in your head to work on what comes next. New in town? The latest episode Just running an errand? Explore the town THE LAiDIES METHOD Your brain kept the references. We put them to work. The plot explains it. The analogy unlocks it. Practice makes it click. The soundtrack makes it stick. Your brain has been saving Clueless, Carrie Bradshaw, “Wannabe,” dial-up tones, butterfly clips and roll-on glitter for years. At LAiDIES, that is not useless trivia. It is a head start. Every lesson unfolds in SUNNYVAiLE—a fictional town tuned to the Rewind Era (1990–2010), where sequential stories, accurate pop-culture analogies, practical activities and original songs work together to make AI easier to understand, use and remember. Listen to the trailer at the Visitors Centre → ▶ Hear the town anthem at KSVL How it all works WHY LAiDIES EXISTS ADA LOVELACE · KEEPER OF THE FIRST ALGORITHM Women have shaped computing from its earliest foundations and helped build the ideas, machines and methods that made modern AI possible. What it becomes next is being decided right now. Getting involved—learning it, using it, having opinions about it—is how we shape the future the way we shaped the past. That is why LAiDIES exists. And since we’re here anyway, we may as well have fun. In the famous words of Founding Mother Karen Spärck Jones: “Computing is too important to be left to men.” — KAREN SPÄRCK JONES · KEEPER OF THE INDEX So join LAiDIES and make sure women continue to light the way. Read their stories at the LUMINAiRY → Listen to Ep 04 · It Was Women All Along → 1 Follow the plot Start with the trailer, then read or hear the episodes in order as our main character learns AI and discovers SUNNYVAiLE alongside you. Season One teaches the AI basics in 24 episodes, because we remember the glory days when a season had time for a proper plot, a questionable haircut and at least one inexplicable musical episode. Future seasons will continue the story—and take your AI fluency further. 2 Unlock the idea Each episode pairs an unfamiliar AI concept with a film, television moment, character, lyric or gloriously specific Y2K reference your brain already understands. Because sometimes “context window” makes more sense when explained through The Devil Wears Prada—and butterfly clips, roll-on glitter and a suspiciously translucent landline have waited long enough to contribute to your professional development. 3 Make it click Take the idea for a spin with a practical Try-On, then reinforce it with a printable guide, Pop Quiz and collectible teaching cards. You’ll finish with something you can actually use—not just another tab you opened with excellent intentions and quietly abandoned three Tuesdays ago. 4 Make it stick KSVL turns central lessons into memorable LAiDIES original songs. Twenty-nine creator-confirmed originals are ready to hear. The player checks the local catalogue and holds only a file with a specific missing, broken, wrong or quality issue. Listen to KSVL 5 Join the town You can explore SUNNYVAiLE without signing up. Becoming a resident opens the community rooms and a device-local Card and Closet while account restoration completes its release checks. At Delta LAi Nu—SUNNYVAiLE’s sorority house—residents can browse room prompts and, when the Hyvor discussion service is available, sign in there to join the conversation. You’ll also unlock Girl Talk, a private honour-system SUNNYVAiLE spin on the classic ’90s truth-or-dare game. Membership is free: no pledging, no rush week and no matching pink velour Juicy tracksuit required—although the outfit is highly encouraged… especially on Wednesdays. See what your local Card and Closet can hold ↓ COME FOR THE WHOLE STORY—OR ONE USEFUL THING What brought you to town today? You do not need to learn the town before you can use it. Take the Wednesday tour Released episodes, then the full eight-stop route through town Look something up Ask Miss Jeeves at the LIBRAiRY reference desk Fix a prompt or get guidance Bring it to the FAiRY Godmother Explore the town Six streets, every destination, and what you do there THE COMPLETE WEEKLY EXPERIENCE Your Wednesday in SUNNYVAiLE On Wednesdays we wear pink. Here, on Wednesdays we do AI—a new episode and its learning activities arrive every Wednesday, a little Mean Girls, a lot more useful. Episodes build on one another: start with the Trailer, then Episode 1. Returning readers, resume the newest episode—the eight-stop Full Route below is the whole experience, and the Express Route is there when you're short on time. WHERE YOU ARE IN THE SEASON Ep 04 · The Founding Mothers T The Trailer 01 On Wednesdays We Do AI 02 Tell Me What You Want 03 The Burn Book Problem 04 The Founding Mothers THIS WEEK ▶ New to LAiDIES? The Trailer introduces SUNNYVAiLE and the story. Then Episode 1 begins the season in order. Explore district → The full town directory — every place, and what you do there SAVE, COLLECT AND CONTINUE Everything you learn—and earn—has somewhere to live. Your Resident Card is your SUNNYVAiLE town ID. Make it at MAiKEOVER on MAiN—it takes about two minutes. Until account and cross-device restoration finish their release checks, Card and Closet progress should be treated as saved on this device. Your Resident Card also opens the doors to Delta LAi Nu, SUNNYVAiLE’s sorority house, and gives you a local Closet inside. Its room prompts are open to browse; live discussion uses Hyvor’s sign-in when that service is available. Delta LAi Nu is also home to Girl Talk, our private honour-system SUNNYVAiLE spin on the classic ’90s truth-or-dare game. It’s considerably more fun than joining yet another professional networking group. Your Closet is where your SUNNYVAiLE life lives: a room of your own at Delta LAi Nu, with a page you can make yours and show off. Inside, you’ll find your progress, saved LIBRAiRY finds and the haul you collect as you explore: Charms — Hidden around town. Spot one and it snaps onto your bracelet. Puffies — Puffy stickers that mark your favourite Handbook pages. The Puffy Board keeps them together. Stickers — Selected quizzes and activities can add device-local keepsakes to your Card. They are not a verified account balance. Trading cards — Collect a pack with every episode. Duplicates are the point: trade them with other residents. Mail — Notes and gifts to your girls through the Post Office. Coming soon. Cher was right: “It does not say RSVP on the Statue of Liberty.” But we’d love yours. Become a SUNNYVAiLE resident—we’ll save you a Closet. Make my Resident Card → Already a resident? Open my Closet → JUST THE MAIL · THE POST OFFICE · CIVIC SQUARE Sign up for the Wednesday Postcard. Not ready to move to town? Get the week delivered instead: the episode, the Study Pack, the Pop Quiz and this week’s AI news—one letter, once a week, no Resident Card needed. A Resident Card does not silently subscribe you. Choose the Postcard separately if you want the weekly email. Sign up at the Post Office LAı DIES Girl power meets machine power. The Rewind Era shaped us. AI is shaping now. SUNNYVAiLE is where they meet.

dom.title: SUNNYVAiLE LIBRAiRY
dom.bodyText: CIVIC SQUARE SUNNYVAiLE LIBRAiRY THE 101s THE TOOLS REFERENCE ARCHITECTURE AND OWNER REVIEW Vocab 101 The useful AI words from across SUNNYVAiLE — translated and arranged A–Z. ARCHITECTURE AND OWNER REVIEW Concepts 101 How it actually works, minus the math — prediction, training, why it sounds so sure. EDITORIAL REVIEW Briefing 101 How to ask so it comes back useful — brief it like a sharp new hire. CURRENCY REVIEW Setup 101 Set it up once so every tool already knows how you work. FACTUAL-INTEGRITY REVIEW Accounts 101 What's safe to paste and what never is — the privacy basics. CURRENTNESS AND DEPTH REVIEW Who's Who in AI Who makes what, and which tool to open for which job. LANDS EP 5 ChatGPT The all-rounder — most people’s first stop for most things. · Lands EP 5 LANDS EP 5 Claude The careful one — a strong writer and thinker. · Lands EP 5 LANDS EP 5 Gemini Google’s one, wired into the Google apps you already use. · Lands EP 5 LANDS EP 5 Copilot AI sitting inside Word, Excel and the rest of Office. · Lands EP 5 LANDS EP 5 Perplexity Answers that come with their sources attached. · Lands EP 5 SOURCE RE-VERIFICATION Straight Answers About AI Sourced answers to the big questions — jobs, data, the environment.
